deposits.interpretation: New York withholding is paid on Form NYS-1 as it accumulates, and the balance with the quarterly NYS-45. If $700 or more of tax has been withheld in the calendar quarter and not yet remitted, it must be filed and paid within 3 or 5 BUSINESS DAYS after the payroll that caused the accumulated tax to equal or exceed $700. 3-DAY filers withheld $15,000 or more in the calendar year that PRECEDES THE PREVIOUS calendar year (the year before last); everyone else, new employers (until notified), educational organizations and health care providers are 5-DAY filers. If there is more than one payroll in a week (Sunday through Saturday), the NYS-1 is not due until after the last payroll of that week (the business days count from that last payroll). When a quarter ends between payrolls of one week, accumulated tax of at least $700 is remitted after the last payroll of the quarter. A balance under $700 left after the last payroll of a quarter in which an NYS-1 was already filed, and the whole tax of a quarter that never reached $700, are paid with the NYS-45, due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31 (next business day if needed); no extensions of time to file or pay are allowed. PrompTax filers follow TR-370-N (not modelled). The Tax Department notifies the employer of a change between 3-day and 5-day. The frequency is an INPUT ('three_day' or 'five_day') or derived from the withholding of the year before last. Payroll Paid Family Leave and disability premiums are not paid with the NYS-1.

returns.name: Form NYS-45, Quarterly Combined Withholding, Wage Reporting, and Unemployment Insurance Return
contents: Employers subject to both UI contributions and withholding tax complete Parts A, B and C (boxes a through j) each quarter.
Employers subject only to UI complete Part A and Part C (boxes a-f) and enter zeros in withholding fields that do not apply.
Employers subject only to withholding complete Part B and Part C (boxes a-e and g-j) and enter zeros in UI fields that do not apply.
Employers with no payroll for the quarter complete Parts A and B and enter 0 in Part C, line 24.
Complete wage information (Part C) for all employees each calendar quarter.
